Research Direction Title: Resource Allocation and Network Management with Edge AI
Short Summary: Develop efficient AI for resource allocation and autonomous network management.
Detailed Description: We study how learning algorithms can manage wireless and satellite resources and execute on edge hardware. Work connects algorithm design with experimental evaluation on AI accelerators.
Motivation: Network decisions must adapt quickly within limited power and computing budgets.
Research Challenges: Dynamic channels; Limited onboard computation; Energy consumption; Real-time inference
Methods: Reinforcement learning; Deep learning; Neuromorphic computing; Edge inference
Applications: Satellite communications; Wireless resource allocation; Onboard signal processing
Keywords: Edge AI; Resource allocation; Neuromorphic computing

Motivation: Collaborative AI requires dependable mechanisms for participation and exchange.
